Bring the Nightmare Shard to Hamuul Runetotem on Elder Rise.

faction.description: This tribe of exiled trolls has joined forces with Thrall and the Horde.  They now call Durotar their home, which they share with their orc allies.
faction.name: Darkspear Trolls

faction.description: Founded by Thrall, this Horde capital city is home to many of the proud orc clans of Durotar.
faction.name: Orgrimmar

faction.description: Cairne Bloodhoof leads his people, the Proud Tauren, from this mighty Horde capital.
faction.name: Thunder Bluff

faction.description: Led by Sylvanas Windrunner, the Forsaken have joined a tenuous alliance with the Horde and established this capital in the vast depths under the Ruins of Lordaeron.
faction.name: Undercity

faction.description: This booming coastal city is run by Baron Revilgaz of the Blackwater Raiders.  Mortal enemies of the Bloodsail Buccaneers and part of the Steamwheedle Cartel.
faction.name: Booty Bay

faction.description: This trading post is run by the goblins of the Steamwheedle Cartel and it sits in the crossroads of Winterspring's main trade routes.
faction.name: Everlook

faction.description: Capital of the Steamwheedle Cartel and home to goblinhood's finest engineers, alchemists and merchants.
faction.name: Gadgetzan

faction.description: A strong arm of the Steamwheedle Cartel, this port is home to seafaring sailors and back-alley dealers spanning the eastern sea trading routes.
faction.name: Powderfuse

faction.description: Part of the Steamwheedle Cartel, this goblin city provides a neutral haven for those that wish to trade goods and services in the Barrens.
faction.name: Ratchet

faction.description: The druids of Cenarion Circle are guardians of nature and make their home in tranquil Moonglade.
faction.name: Cenarion Circle

faction.description: The Earthen Ring is a loose collective of Horde-aligned shamans and druids who seek to maintain and nurture the balance of nature on Azeroth.
faction.name: Earthen Ring

faction.description: The secretive druids of the Shadowgale Forest. They operate independently, apart from any other faction on Zephras Isle.
faction.name: Nightclaw Druids

faction.description: The Windshapers are shamanistic spiritual leaders of the Skyborne people on Zephras Isle. They honor the elements and seek to gain a better understanding of the nature of the elemental plane to protect the shen'dorei way of life within Skywall.
faction.name: Windshapers

3369.text: Bring the Nightmare Shard to Hamuul Runetotem on Elder Rise.
